body: Quick pass (M5): `setup_align::part_aabb_in` excludes anything carrying `FixtureDef` (vise, accessory, plate, chuck, tagged STEP/mesh); Top and Bottom of Model read it; `is_model` and the collision checks are untouched. Five pins in heights_fixtures, including that the collision check still sees the vise. The filter mutation fails all four height pins, and the collision mutation fails only pin 5, so the two are pinned separately. The quick gate plus 24 suites and clippy are green; goldens unchanged. The base line is corrected to upstream main 41cd9c2. Follow-up #1538 (P1: fit-stock-to-models and the stock strip also measure fixtures). Flagged ready; a review by the other session is next (safety tier).

Review fixes pushed: 47704e3a (`test(heights): pin the setup-frame transform and the no-part refusal`, Refs #1529). The commit changes tests only, in `crates/app/tests/heights_fixtures.rs`. There are now 8 pins.

**New pins**
1. `a_tilted_setup_reads_the_part_in_its_own_frame_with_a_vise_present`: Setup1 is tilted [90,0,0] with `AlignPartToSetup::angles`. Top and Bottom of Model read Z -18..32, so the 50 mm side stands up. Adding a vise in Setup1 leaves both values unchanged.
2. `with_only_fixtures_left_the_model_heights_refuse_no_model_loaded`: `block` is tagged as a fixture and a vise is added. Both references resolve to `None`, and `missing_source` gives `Some("no model loaded")` for both TopOfModel and BottomOfModel. `GenerateOperation::new` refuses with `unresolved: no model loaded`.
3. Note (not blocking): `the_collision_check_still_sees_the_vise` now asserts directly that `posting::verification_gate` is empty for its no-vise control (the same -3 mm pass with no fixture). `the_collision_check_passes_the_bare_contour_with_the_vise_under_the_part` was added beside it: default heights with the vise under the part, and the gate is empty, so generate and post agree.

**Mutation checks** (each applied alone, then reverted)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `models_aabb_in` reads `model::world_facets` instead of `facets_in` (frame dropped) | red: `a_tilted_setup_reads_the_part_in_its_own_frame_with_a_vise_present` (the other 7 green) |
| `missing_source` reverted to `model::solid_world_aabb(world)` | red: `with_only_fixtures_left_the_model_heights_refuse_no_model_loaded` (left `None`, right `Some("no model loaded")`) |
| restored | 8/8 green |

**Gate** (macOS arm64, sccache): heights_fixtures 8, heights 11, heights_selection 9 and setup_align 10 all passed. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.

Not done here: the WCS-pane model-bounds anchor (moved to #1538's scope) and the file-size notes.

Ready for a re-review.

**Delta re-review @ 47704e3a** (test-only, since b3107a5f): **clean**, `merge-ready`.

Both requested pins are added, and I re-ran each mutation:
1. **Frame transform:** `a_tilted_setup_reads_the_part_in_its_own_frame_with_a_vise_present`. Changing `models_aabb_in` to read `model::world_facets` instead of `facets_in(.., declared)` fails this pin and nothing else.
2. **No part left:** `with_only_fixtures_left_the_model_heights_refuse_no_model_loaded`. Reverting `missing_source` to `model::solid_world_aabb` fails this pin and nothing else.

`heights_fixtures` passes 8/8 on the head. `verification_gate` is now asserted empty on the control. The WCS-anchor note was moved into #1538's scope.
